verdict.rationale: Customer.io ships AI features (an in-product agent, an MCP server, a CLI, and AI-generated styles), so whether customer data trains AI models is a fair privacy question for this product. The evidence pack has nothing on AI training policies, opt-outs, or data-use guarantees for its AI features. The data-residency and synthetic-email item covers where PII is stored, not model training, so it does not count here.
